title: The Tower of Nostradamus/Quotes
summary:
"Sorry miss, your call cannot be completed as dialled!"
- Hoffman to Annette

"Lok, have you ever actually flown the plane?!" (Cherit)

"Technically... no." (Lok Lambert)

"If there's one class Lok can stay awake in, it's flight class."
- Sophie Casterwill to Lok Lambert

"Surprises, surprises. You're full of surprises, Dante Vale."
- Wilder to Dante Vale
